lines.l: Clouds are all heavy, but I don't care
I'd hold on to your promise, you'd be there
Homes and dreams and the mess we made
Strong scale is breaking, the night's getting loud
We both know there is no way out
Hold my hand when I fall in the deep
The roar I found now, sounds so sweet
Skylines make us with our hearts on fire
We're pulling fast, chasing the wind in the wire
Paper planes, hurricanes, all the harps on the breeze and the mess we made
All of my love remains, paper planes and hurricanes
